application.name: Connext Shapes with Holoviz
application.description: Holoscan-generated Shapes visualized locally and exchanged with RTI Connext DDS.

changelog.0.1.0: Initial Holoscan 5 EA2 Connext Shapes and Holoviz reference application

square.description: Publish and display a local black Square

circle.description: Publish a red Circle for a second application or RTI Shapes Demo

triangle.description: Publish a green Triangle for a second application or RTI Shapes Demo

headless_square.description: Publish and display a local black Square on an Xvfb display

headless_circle.description: Publish and display an external red Circle on an Xvfb display

run.command: bash -lc "export DISPLAY=:100 XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp; Xvfb :100 -screen 0 800x800x24 >/tmp/xvfb.log 2>&1 & exec <holohub_app_bin>/connext_shapes_holoviz --publish-topic Circle --publish-color RED"
